cases.name: Kimberly Horas Uvenio
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Kim volunteered as a CCD Teacher at St. Bernard R.C. Church for many years. She was an avid animal lover, enjoyed going to the beach with her family, and spending quality time with her family. Kim had a smile that would light up every room she walked in to. Her laugh was contagious, she had a huge heart, and lived her life for her two children."
